item.title: Network & K8s.05-2 Outside In, Routes and Gateways
item.description: Trace external traffic into Kubernetes by separating LoadBalancer address allocation and advertisement from the Service datapath, then follow Ingress host/path routing, TLS termination, and Gateway API ownership, attachment permissions, and status-based diagnosis.

item.title: Network & K8s.01-1 Inside One Host
item.description: One curl request to a local Go server, captured on lo0 and taken apart byte by byte — layers and encapsulation, the TCP handshake and connection states, TLS 1.3 vs 1.2 with decryption, and UDP with ICMP rejections.
